products.name: NPI 2-Way Insulated Screwdriver
products.description: An electrician's screwdriver with a fully insulated, reversible blade: slotted on one end, Phillips on the other. Pull the blade out, flip it and you have the second tip in seconds. The bright red-and-yellow soft-grip handle is easy to spot in a tool bag and comfortable for long panel jobs.

products.name: NPI 2-Way Screwdriver (Full Rod)
products.description: One handle, two drivers. The hardened steel rod slides fully through the handle and reverses from slotted to Phillips. The contoured yellow-and-black grip gives you real turning force without blisters.

products.name: Milestone Phillips Screwdriver (Yellow Grip)
